title: Variant Start
text: Define start of bounded region, 1 input, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Variant control mode} sets Variant control mode; {Variant Start End Tag} sets the unique identifier of bounded, {Variant activation time} sets the time when software chooses active variant choice update, {Port and associated conditions} sets the table of variant choices, variant controls, and conditions empty, {Port} sets the number of connected output port Read-only: no, {Variant control label} sets the name of choice in label mode true, {Variant control expression} sets the condition expression that determines the active choice true, {Condition (read-only)} sets the condition expression in Simulink.VariantExpression object Read-only, {Label mode active choice} sets the name of active choice in label mode and {Show variant condition on block} sets the annotate block ports. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_N
ports.summary: Output from N th branch scalar | vector | matrix
